c: p:my little pony friendship is magic
d:
Fluttershy fulfilled her dream of setting up her animal sanctuary in Ponyville.
However, she struggles with paying the bills, and Mr Filthy Rich - her largest financial backer - takes full advantage of her problems to the displeasure of her recent hire, a young Kirin named Aka.

Hello friends and AI-haters!

For this release I went a step beyond just slapping a title page together for one of the many excellent AI galleries out there.

I went ahead and made a full comic book out of three of MasterDarhil's fantastic sets - after spending too many hours fixing all the generation errors in addition to all the rest of the work necessary to make a proper comic book.

I hereby proudly present issue one of the Lifted Tails Anthology series, where I will try my best to turn good AI generations into good comic books.

Enjoy!
